crypto.generation: Before device request privately persist independent device_secret and runtime_secret: 32 random bytes each encoded as 64 lowercase hex characters. Never print either.
crypto.commitment: lowercase hex SHA256 of UTF-8 secret string (NOT decoded bytes and NOT full prefixed token).
crypto.runtime_token: aeon_<runtime_prefix>_<runtime_secret>. Existing auth hashes secret component only. Server returns prefix, never secret.
crypto.proof: device_secret only in JSON HTTPS request body for redeem/reconcile; never URL, query, argv or logs. Persistent device proof authorizes only this request/tombstone, never general APIs.

request.tenant_id: canonical tenant UUID from signed-in guide; no tenant enumeration

accounts.label: visible vendor account identity <=128
accounts.model_profile_id: enabled tenant model UUID, or omitted for server choice

POST /api/agent-pairing/redeem.response: PairingView; pending/denied/expired states are HTTP 200, no runtime binding until approved; successful first/repeated redemption returns same bindings, never refills or starts another run

cleanup_confirmed_account_ids: only locally cleaned enrolled account UUIDs
request.computer_cleanup_confirmed: bool; only after owned work drains and safe local cleanup

POST /api/agent-pairing/reconcile.response: PairingView; tombstone-only, cannot issue keys, reset grants, dispatch, settle active work or resurrect pairing

POST /api/agent-pairing/lookup.response: PairingView with immutable details, request_digest and exact verification terms

POST /api/agent-pairing/requests/{reques.response: PairingView; repeat identical approval is idempotent; altered choice conflicts

POST /api/agent-pairing/self/disconnect.permission: own paired agent with run.claim; no other computer IDs accepted

request.account_id: optional UUID of own enrollment; omitted means whole computer

requested_accounts: same validated account fields as device request

verification.task: Reply exactly AEON_VERIFIED. Do not use tools, read or modify files, execute commands, or access the network.

integration.workspace: tenant_id is Aeon workspace; workspace_path is local folder. Both immutable approval inputs.
integration.polling: 5 seconds minimum, honor 429 Retry-After; bounded request lifetime 10 minutes; verification expiry fixed at request +30 minutes.
integration.accounts: One explicitly chosen account per harness per request, at most four; account IDs and daemon ID returned by server must replace local guesses.
integration.verification: Created atomically exactly once on approval, using existing work-order/run/allowance machinery. Daemon consumes ordinary queued runs; must honor server-provided harmless task and duration. Never create runs from setup retry.
integration.drain: Immediately fence dispatch/reservation/claim; allow only already-active telemetry settlement. Reconcile/self/get completes drain once no active runs remain.
integration.revoke_now: Immediate server fence; full removal revokes runtime key. Local processes remain unconfirmed and cleanup pending. Device proof permits tombstone reconciliation only.
integration.selective: A removed enrollment cannot be probed, reserved, claimed or resurrected by manual registration; other accounts keep working.
integration.metadata: Owned probe/metadata and route use run.claim; list uses account.read. Paired runtime cannot widen approved model profiles via metadata.
integration.ongoing_limits: Separately authenticated person via existing allowance API; no runtime authority.
integration.add_harness: Fresh device approval required; existing computer extension contract will be finalized before implementation if supported.
